question: Which district has more paved road per 1,000 residents in 2025, Coldharbour or Stonecairn, and by how many km per 1,000 residents?

result.final_text:
Coldharbour has more paved road per 1,000 residents. Coldharbour: 598.3 ÷ 11.407 = 52.449 km; Stonecairn: 506.8 ÷ 14.926 = 33.957 km. Difference: 18.492 km per 1,000 residents.

ANSWER: Coldharbour | 18.492
